## Personal Overview

Naufal Rizqullah Firdaus is a Computer Engineering graduate of IPB University (Institut Pertanian Bogor) who approaches technology from a holistic, system-level perspective rather than isolated coding tasks.

His work is shaped by:
- understanding real-world problems and operational needs
- designing structured systems before implementation
- prioritizing reliability, maintainability, and efficiency
- using code as a tool to support larger system goals

He is particularly interested in how systems are:
- designed from requirements
- integrated across multiple components
- operated in real environments
- maintained over time with minimal friction

---

## Professional Overview

Naufal builds end-to-end systems that integrate:

- Software applications (web systems, APIs, backend services)
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker, Linux environments)
- IoT and embedded systems (ESP32, MQTT, real-time monitoring)
- AI-powered workflows (LLM integration, LangChain, automation tools)

His approach emphasizes:
- system integration over isolated feature development
- automation to reduce manual work and increase consistency
- real-time data flow and monitoring
- structured and maintainable architecture

---

## Engineering Approach

- Starts from real use cases and operational requirements
- Designs systems before focusing on implementation details
- Breaks down complex systems into manageable components
- Connects software, hardware, and infrastructure into unified solutions
- Focuses on long-term usability, not just short-term functionality
- Communicates technical concepts clearly within teams

Structured data: every page emits JSON-LD. The Person entity is published
under the stable identifier https://naufalrf.net/#person, and the site under
https://naufalrf.net/#website, so references resolve to one entity across
pages. /about additionally emits ProfilePage, /projects and /publications emit
CollectionPage with an ItemList, and /services emits Service with an
OfferCatalog.
  Site-aware assistant for answering questions about this portfolio
